visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting four figures carrying a large, overturned bark canoe on their shoulders across a rugged, wooded landscape near a body of water. The figures are dressed in frontier-style clothing, including tunics, leggings, and headgear, and are equipped with long rifles and knives. The style is characteristic of late 19th-century book illustration.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Large bark canoe, long rifles, knives, sheaths, tunics, leggings, moccasins, rocky terrain, trees, water.
